hook_b: Want to practise law? You have till *tonight*
tldr: Registration for AIBE 22, the Bar Council of India's exam for law graduates, closes today, October 27. Fees can be paid till October 28 and forms corrected till October 30. The exam is on November 29.

beats.what: The Bar Council of India's AIBE 22 registration window shuts today on allindiabarexamination.com.
beats.why: Clearing AIBE gets you the Certificate of Practice (CoP), which you need to practise as an advocate.
beats.care: Final-year or fresh LLB? Register today, pay by Oct 28. Miss it and you wait for the next round.

cards.body: Dates to save: register Oct 27, pay fee Oct 28, fix mistakes till Oct 30, admit card Nov 14, exam Nov 29. Fee is ₹3,560 for General/OBC and ₹2,560 for SC/ST, bank charges included.

cards.why: Nov 29. The admit card comes out Nov 14.

learn.t: Certificate of Practice (CoP): the Bar Council's licence that lets an enrolled advocate practise in Indian courts. AIBE is the exam you clear to get it.

watch: Correction window till Oct 30; admit card on Nov 14.
